lines.a: 有一個嬰孩為我們降生
lines.b: A baby boy has come, born for you and me
God's beloved son came to this world

lines.a: 祢的名字為和平的君王
lines.b: Your name shall always be Jesus, prince of peace

lines.a: 以馬內利 如此靠近我們
lines.b: Emmanuel, You are so near to us

lines.a: 祢的名稱為奇妙策士 全能神
lines.b: Glorify, Your wonderful name. Mighty counselor

lines.a: 將平安賜給祢所愛的人
lines.b: and give eternal peace to those You love
God's only Son came down for us

lines.a: 以馬內利 神與我們同在
lines.b: Emmanuel, our God is with us

lines.a: 祢是恩典 祢是救贖
lines.b: for You've redeemed us with Your love
You poured out Your peace and Your hope

lines.a: 愛我們不計較任何代價
lines.b: You gave everything for Your love for us
